Psychometric swap curve is nice; circularity of model-own-embedding similarity (own risk note) plus crowded tracker-robustness space keep it at borderline.
Real aliasing physics, but scope is periodic-motion scenes only - a workshop curiosity unless it changes fps guidance for a deployed domain.

Frame-selection for interactive VOS is a published genre (frame-recommendation papers, IVOS round protocols); budget framing is a delta, not a discovery.
Hours-cheap metric audit with rank-flip stakes; both outcomes publishable. Exactly the kind of falsification the VOS community avoids running. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
Inference-time memory-selection improvements for SAM2 are already a small industry (SAMURAI motion-aware memory, SAM2Long memory tree); the regime-split residual is thin.

SAM2 keeps per-object memory (own KNOWN note); the residual contention channels (shared backbone, resolution) make any positive finding small and architecture-version-fragile.
Scale-lag time constant is a crisp, cheap, signed measurement; on its own a short paper - strongest bundled with 0029's erosion bias as a 'memory low-pass' study.
Cycle-consistency-as-confidence is classic (flow, tracking); the calibration-vs-model-confidence comparison for SAM2 is useful engineering but thin science. Blind-where-needed risk is real.
Boundary-release hysteresis as an amodal-representation probe is original; measuring it rides on GT quality in exactly the noisiest annotation region.
Segmenting what no single frame shows is a real capability gap with a constructive fix (motion amplification); data must be built, which is the price of a new task.

Survival-analysis vocabulary (hazard, absorbing states, memoryless recovery) imported into VOS gives deployment-relevant numbers current benchmarks hide; threshold sensitivity is manageable. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
Memory-size sweeps without retraining may be off-manifold (own risk), and SAM2Long-style work already explores the memory-budget axis with stronger engineering.

Budget-matched protocol comparison is the question every video-annotation team actually has; simulator + small human confirmation is the right two-stage design. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

Mechanistic attribution (speckle decorrelation vs anatomy) with a preprocessing-vs-fine-tuning matched-cost duel; MICCAI-shaped and CAMUS is public. Diagnostic-boundary co-evaluation is essential. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
Change-point self-diagnosis is plausible engineering; gradual drifts without change points (own risk) and overlap with 0040's cheaper signal cap the upside.
Editing structure as a controlled probe is elegant; the all-cuts-fail flattening risk is likely given SAM2's known cut brittleness, leaving a thin negative.
Latent-linearity of masklet embeddings is a real representational question with a 4-10x efficiency payoff; pixel-interpolation baseline could trivially win, which is the gamble.
Stationarity as a distinct failure regime is true and unmodeled (surveillance/ecology care); mask GT scarcity for fixed-camera streams is the blocking cost.

Lit-attack CONFIRMED KILL: Lemay et al. MELBA 2022 (arXiv:2202.07550) directly compares STAPLE vs averaging vs per-rater random sampling for calibration + inter-rater variability preservation + Dice; EDUE (arXiv:2403.16594) and rater-specific Bayesian nets extend. The question is answered.

Information-preservation argument is the sharp part (perturbations a radiologist provably tolerates); learnable-windowing papers exist but the fragility audit itself may be open. Needs radiologist-validated ranges.
Fully subsumed by W2-A-0062's dimensionless crossover law; keeping both dilutes the same experiment.

Pathological-size failure is exactly the clinically dangerous case benchmarks average away; MedSAM box-perturbation studies exist, so the size-percentile stratification must carry the paper. Matched-difficulty control is mandatory.
Tissue-characterization literature has long treated speckle as signal; the segmentation-specific 2x2 ablation is a modest but real gap. Filter-dependence risk is handled by the 3-filter design.
Tellez et al. (Med Image Anal 2019) ran essentially this factorial: augmentation dominates normalization cross-site. The per-class sign-flip residual is not enough to resurrect it.

Supervision-modality-matching hypothesis is the interesting core; Dice-per-dollar methodology is fragile (NLP extraction quality is a moving target, own note). MICCAI-viable if costs are instrumented honestly.
Directional uncertainty vs isotropic models, anchored to radiotherapy margins, is a genuinely new axis; data scarcity (multi-rater glioma + orientation fields) is the tax. Protect as HRHR.
Longitudinal SSL is plausible and ADNI/OASIS are public, but matched-compute pretraining duels are expensive and the registration-shortcut risk needs careful objective design.

Lit-attack: mechanism known and mitigated - marginal/exclusion loss (Shi et al., arXiv:2007.03868), COSST, ConDistFL all treat unlabeled-organ-as-background as the core partial-label failure. Surviving sliver: quantified dose-response poisoning curve + effect-size-vs-architecture comparison. MUTATE with low remaining novelty.
'Topology is lost at checkpoint-selection time, not training time' is a sharp, cheap, actionable reframing of the clDice line; every checkpoint is already logged in a normal run. Best of C03.

Dimensionless spacing/diameter crossover would upgrade nnU-Net-style heuristics into a law; heavy training grid is the cost. Native-anisotropy validation leg is non-negotiable. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
Post-hoc fatigue forensics on public datasets is an original, label-free audit; quality-proxy indirectness is the weak joint, patched by small spot re-annotation.

'Domain gap is mostly signal-processing gap' is a useful decomposition, but low-level/semantic distances are confounded in the wild; the synthetic-perturbation leg does the real work and shrinks the claim.

Real-click-vs-simulator gap has landed for natural images (RClicks-style work); the clinician-specific corpus and method-reordering claim remain open and MICCAI-relevant. Small-N is survivable if traces are released. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

SynthSeg already demonstrated contrast-agnostic segmentation via aggressive synthetic contrast randomization; physics-consistent inversion is an augmentation flavor, not a new question. Pathology-erasure caveat further narrows it.
Useful regime map for tiny-lesion pipelines; the implementation-asymmetry confound (own note) is the classic reviewer kill and hard to fully neutralize.

Seed-dependent bimodality + metric decoupling in the extreme-imbalance regime is a real phenomenon nobody has pinned down; the synthetic imbalance ladder is the right instrument. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

Physics augmentation for MRI is established in reconstruction, and the decomposition's ceiling is set by simulation fidelity to proprietary pipelines (own risk note) - the conclusion is uninterpretable when closure fails.
Physically-motivated and probably right, but cross-operator data scarcity means a phantom study carries the claim - thin for a main venue, good MICCAI workshop-to-paper ladder.

'Which leaderboards have crossed their own noise floor' is a field-level service with teeth; the style-vs-anatomy error decomposition is what elevates it above known single-dataset inter-rater studies.
Prompt-space (not image-space) anatomical normalization is a neat inversion, and failure-as-anomaly-detector is a bonus claim; landmark-detector co-failure (own note) entangles exactly that bonus.
Site/scanner fingerprints are established in radiomics and site-invariance methods exist in federated medical imaging; the joint quantification is consolidation, not discovery.

Anti-conservative volume CIs from boundary-correlated errors is a precise, checkable, clinically consequential claim with a constructive fix; synthetic-lesion anchor kills the GT-uncertainty objection. Top-3 in batch A.
Outcome-anchored test of consensus erasing the correct minority expert is the most ethically loaded finding available in this cluster; data access is the wall. Protect as HRHR. Lit-attacked below.

'Benchmarks measure style, not smoke' with a ranking-flip demonstration is a field-resetting audit; smoke-density/matting lines exist so the agreement-study leg must carry novelty. Lit-attacked below.
The regression-beats-binary-ON-binary claim is crisp and falsifiable; pairs naturally with 0076 as its constructive half. Compositing realism is the shared weak point.
Artifact-reliance for emissive phenomena is a real deployment issue; the saturation-is-also-signal confound (own note) demands HDR counterfactuals that raise the cost.

Flicker-frequency analysis is the backbone of 2000s-era video fire detection (wavelet flicker methods, ~10 Hz signatures); the matched-FLOPs modern restaging is engineering, not discovery. Compression caveat is the one live finding.
Occlusion-based information decomposition is standard interpretability machinery applied to a fresh class pair; the matched-scene-pair control decides whether the number means anything.

Divergence-as-earliness on ignition-anchored videos is a well-posed physics bet; flow noise at low contrast (own note) may eat the earliness margin, which is exactly what the experiment measures. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
Measuring the implicit alpha-cutoff distribution of annotators is original psychophysics with direct dataset-harmonization payoff; controlled alpha ramps make it decisive.
Synthetic-to-real fog transfer was the explicit subject of the Foggy Cityscapes/Foggy Zurich/CMAda line (Sakaridis et al.); the heterogeneity-index regression is a residual, not a paper.
Contrast-sign regime stratification is a solid dataset audit but reads as one figure in a bigger smoke-benchmark paper (e.g. inside 0076) rather than standalone work.
Sun-geometry forensic verification of label errors is a genuinely new audit instrument (labels falsified by celestial mechanics); off-nadir overlap geometry is the technical hurdle.
Shutter-speed-as-confound is a sharp observation about weather datasets; controlled capture logistics push the decisive version out of reach, and the simulation version convinces nobody.
Ripple-amplitude psychometric curve for reflection confusion is clean and cheap; overlaps the C05 mirror agenda - merge candidate with the phantom-source census (0125-adjacent).

Steam-vs-smoke as a minimal pair is the right way to isolate the discriminative cue for translucent media; deliberate source-variety collection is the real cost and worth it. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

'Information is destroyed before the model' is the right counter-narrative to scaling; requires controlled-burn bracketed capture, and legacy-camera inapplicability (own note) blunts the deployment claim.

Time-to-detect reformulation is the highest-value framing in the cluster, BUT the wildfire camera-network line (FIgLib/SmokeyNet, tower-camera programs) already benchmarks detection latency - the segmentation-vs-accumulation duel is the surviving question. Lit-attacked below. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

Human-preference validation of segmentation metrics for amorphous classes could reorder the subfield; per-use-case preference collection (own note) is the difference between a metric paper and an opinion poll.
Super-multiplicative failure on translucency compositions is a good compositional-generalization probe; physical capture of stacked media is a real logistics bill.
The fire-invariant/smoke-not split is a nice physics prediction; scale confounds with distance, atmosphere and compression make the clean ladder hard to certify.
Factorial realism ablation answers the question every synthetic-data team guesses at; 8-cell render+train grid is a heavy compute bill for a cluster of this kind.
Ego-motion compensation for aerial temporal cues is competent engineering hygiene; the synthetic-ego-motion protocol lacks parallax by its own admission, and the finding is an ablation table.
Band attribution for the smoke/shadow confusion is useful to the remote-sensing community (venue fit is there, not CVPR); retrain-without-band leg makes it honest.
Passive shimmer segmentation as a pre-smoke fire channel is the most original constructive idea in C04; wind/vibration confounds are real but controllable on fixed cameras. Protect as HRHR.

METAR-validated self-supervised fog density is a lovely free-label loop; depth-estimator circularity (own note) plus existing visibility-estimation literature in transportation research keep it at borderline pending a lit check.

Hours-cheap shortcut audit (mask the fire, watch accuracy persist) with a paired auto/fixed-exposure confirmation; inpainting-leak caveat is handled by multiple masking strategies. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
Provenance-level leakage audit of smoke/fire benchmarks is cheap, decisive, and likely devastating; the genre exists in other domains, which helps rather than hurts the method's credibility.

Frame-vs-interior evidence decomposition is the single most informative cheap probe of what glass models learned; run jointly with 0112's hallucination corollary as one paper. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

Correspondence-density difficulty law is plausible and cheap to fit; mirror-detection architectures already exploit correspondence explicitly, so the finding may confirm the field's intuition rather than surprise it.
Warp-field pretext has roots in refractive-flow work (fluid wiggles, Schlieren-adjacent); the cross-category transfer measurement is the unclaimed part. Textureless blind spot honestly bounded.

'Transparency is outside SAM's object ontology' as a categorical claim is a strong, cheap probe with prompt-engineering ladders as the built-in rebuttal test; transmission/reflection stratification keeps it honest. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

Sensor-weakness-as-data-engine at fleet scale is the constructive flagship of C05; individual depth-invalidity cues are published, so the scaling claim and filtering recipe must carry it. Lit-attacked below.
Convention forensics with a free transfer-recovery payoff; solid but reads as a strong section of a benchmark-reform paper rather than standalone.
Rank inversion across the clarity axis would genuinely change how transparency leaderboards are read; hinges on clarity estimation without optics GT, which the calibration subset only partly fixes.
Physics-forced diurnal class flip inside a fixed scene, with annotate-once economics and a control-surface design; among the most elegant experimental setups in the batch.

Information-theoretically-invisible glass regions polluting benchmarks is a claim that, if true, invalidates a slice of every published score; small human study is the entire cost. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
The open-frame hallucination corollary is the best single figure of the frame-reliance story; as a separate idea from 0101 it double-counts - merge and keep once.
Quantified antagonism between two preprocessing choices is a 3x3 ablation table; useful engineering note, not a research bet.
The driving-fleet instantiation of 0107; precision-of-mined-labels audit is the gating experiment. Merge into 0107 as its at-scale leg rather than keeping separately.

Meniscus-as-refraction-discontinuity is a charming task with robotics/lab-automation buyers; requires building the container-ladder dataset from scratch, and prior robotic liquid-perception work needs checking.
Fun diagnostic, honestly self-described as a niche probe; zero-representation-of-reflection is better established via 0121's safety-relevant version.
Caustics as transparent-object shadows is the kind of physics-first idea nobody else will try; directional-lighting operating envelope honestly narrows scope. Protect as HRHR.

'Method deltas fall inside the refractive-edge annotation noise band' is a statistically decisive kill-shot on boundary-level transparency rankings; a funded annotation study is the whole bill. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
Setting-vs-category attribution matters for the next dataset's design; post-hoc descriptor regression is weak causal ground and the controlled-recapture leg is expensive.
RGB-thermal glass segmentation with paired datasets is published (RGB-T glass detection line); the economic-accounting framing does not survive the existence of the dataset papers.

Geometrically-verified phantom objects in puddles is a hidden, safety-relevant, metric-invisible error class with a built-in verification method (mirror symmetry about the road plane); best forensic idea in C05.
Shadow-luminance alpha inversion is inventive physics; multi-source lighting and interreflection corruption (own note) restrict it to strong-sun regimes, and the calibrated validation is lab-heavy.

Display-rejection via rolling-shutter banding is clever and cheap; the sensor-display compatibility matrix (own note) may show the tell vanishing exactly on modern hardware, dating the method on arrival.

'Benchmarks oversample dirty, easy glass' is a sharp distribution-shift claim against building-stock reality; contamination scoring subjectivity is the soft underbelly, partly fixed by the controlled facade capture.
Construction-era stratification is a clever confound hunt, but era entangles frames, cleanliness, and context (own note); the multi-covariate story is too soft to headline.

Two dissociable camouflage mechanisms (semantic mimicry vs texture continuity) with a human-anchored factor analysis; psychophysics rigor is the entry fee. Anchors the whole C06 reform agenda. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
Center/single-object bias stress test is cheap and probably damning; center bias is an old SOD critique so the COD-specific empirical numbers are the only new asset.
Video-COD on MoCA is an established subfield, so 'motion helps camouflage' is known; the bits-per-frame information curve is the surviving quantitative delta.

Joint SOD-COD modeling exploiting their contradictory relationship is published (uncertainty-aware joint SOD/COD, CVPR 2021); the linear-direction probe is a cleaner instrument for a settled question.

Mechanism-stratified evaluation grounded in camouflage biology (Cott's principles) is the right taxonomy; needs biologist annotation and multi-label handling, and COD10K's existing attributes partially overlap.

Consensus-core re-scoring is an afternoon of compute with a real chance of exposing style-imitation rewards; the annotation-team correlation is the killer figure if it lands. Merge candidate with 0091/0118 metric-reform line.

Machine-visible chromatic microstructure as a non-perceptual shortcut, tied to cross-camera failure, is a solid forensic; needs the human baseline and psychophysically-verified ablations it prescribes.
Bio-vs-artificial camouflage transfer is data-blocked (military camouflage sets are not public) and the phase-statistics story is speculative; defense-adjacent framing also complicates venues.
'COD progress is implicit scale-search progress' is a bold reduction; the oracle-leakage protocol problem (own note) is exactly where reviewers will aim, and the fix is nontrivial.

A quantified supervision-crossover criterion (when binary labels become counterproductive) is a reusable decision rule for every fuzzy class; matting data with true alpha makes it controlled. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

'Ambiguity is more domain-invariant than object identity' is a genuinely deep claim with a clean zero-shot test; must control protocol/skill confounds (own note) and dodge the multi-rater modeling literature by staying on the transfer question.
Context-saturation curves as a computational task signature are cheap and tidy; the result is a characterization, and its main value is feeding the 0326 context-monotonicity agenda.

The COD-medical bridge is already built: the Concealed Object Detection line explicitly spans camouflage and polyp/lesion segmentation with shared architectures. Channel-ablation localization does not rescue it.
Conditional recall after the first find (inhibition-of-return deficit) is an original behavioral probe borrowed from visual-search psychology; ecology relevance (herds) gives it real stakes.
Compression-halo forensics of COD is hours-cheap with real embarrassment potential; overlaps 0018's grid-forensics toolkit - bundle as one 'artifact forensics' paper.
Time-accuracy curve matching is suggestive-only by its own admission (curve similarity is weak mechanistic evidence); the human data collection is the expensive half of a soft conclusion.

'Difficulty lives in the scene, not the animal' with a compositing intervention is a good causal design; COD10K attribute analyses have circled this without the intervention leg, which is the part to protect.
Testing whether undecidability itself is reliably annotatable is a foundational annotation-theory question disguised as a COD study; the exclusion-mask retraining leg makes it constructive.
Motion-magnification preprocessing for hidden-animal detection is plausible and cheap to pilot; overlaps 0042's micro-motion agenda (same bet, different task) - keep exactly one of the pair.

Datasets contain only failed camouflage - a selection-bias claim that bounds the unmeasurable, testable via telemetry-verified presence. Ecology collaboration is the wall; upside is a permanent asterisk on every COD number. Lit-attacked below.
May reduce to known contrast measures by its own admission; the angular component is a thin bet for a full project, and COD difficulty-attribute analyses already crowd this space.
Shadow-geometry as an unfakeable channel is physically sound with near-independent errors as the payoff claim; directional-light-only envelope and shadow-evidence annotation costs keep it borderline.

Lit-attacked: soft-vs-hard highlighting literature (NSF visual-search studies) already shows soft/graded confidence beats hard binary highlights and hard highlighting can mask non-highlighted targets. Surviving mutation: camouflage/COD-specific teaming with calibration quality as moderator and segmentation-mask anchoring mechanism. MUTATE but keep.
Physical/3D adversarial camouflage synthesis is a mature literature (adversarial textures, clothing, vehicle wraps); the transfer-matrix delta does not clear the bar.

Scale-relativity of boundary ground truth attacks an unexamined axiom (that a single correct boundary exists independent of viewing scale); if the systematic shift is real, mixed-resolution training is provably mis-specified. Interface controls are essential.

Per-benchmark boundary error budgets (model vs annotation vs metric) would recalibrate every sub-3px progress claim; sampling design from 200 objects to benchmark-wide claims is the statistical crux. Lit-attacked below.
Inference-only longitudinal audit with a devastating potential headline ('five years of progress never reached the smallest decile'); reproduction of official numbers is the only gate.

Analytic sharpness floor validated on the model zoo makes 'losses are second-order for sharpness' a checkable claim; learned upsamplers as empirical kernels is the right pragmatic move. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
The aliasing family (0003, 0154, 0165) is one paper, not three; 0003's phase-sweep causal design is the strongest instantiation - fold gap-periodicity in as a section.

Threshold-based perceptual boundary metric is the constructive complement to the C07 audits; per-use-case weights (own note) double the study size but are what makes it defensible. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

Annotation-tool fingerprints are a genuinely new forensic axis with a transfer-recovery payoff; the tool-content confound needs the same-content multi-tool validation set, which nobody has - build it or drop the claim.
Occlusion-sweep information ratios are a known interpretability recipe; the size-crossover is one figure inside 0171's cleaner attribution question.

The iso-compute resolution-vs-capacity frontier is the question practitioners actually face; the shift-invariance compounding claim is the novel bit. Full grid is compute-heavy and family-replication doubles it.
Ecosystem-scale wasted-vertex accounting is a fun audit and the DP-optimal frontier is free to compute; whether human motor costs follow vertex economics (own note) decides if it means anything.

Hours-cheap, immediately actionable (one morphological parameter per class), and diagnostic of how much 'boundary error' is just bias; the residual-structure measurement doubles as the follow-up map. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

Curvature-resolved error laws with architecture cutoff frequencies are good measurement science; synthetic-shape anchors solve the noisy-GT curvature problem. Competes with 0153/0174 for the same paper slot.
'The model flinches where it cannot see' is a lovely hypothesis; the texture-boundary base rate (own note) is exactly where such detectors historically die. Cheap enough to gamble on.

'Stuff-stuff boundaries are measure-zero fictions' is a sharp ontological claim with a cheap multi-annotator test and a concrete evaluation reform (band-aware scoring); the band-vs-edge classifier is the honest prerequisite.

Minimum-evaluable-object-size per dataset, derived by propagating measured annotation jitter, is a permanent public good; 'statistically vacuous SOTA claims' is the kind of finding that survives every rebuttal.
Shift-variance of CNNs is a published genre (anti-aliasing line); the small-object phase-flip quantification belongs inside 0003's phase-sweep paper, not as a third aliasing project.
Hidden cost of gradient-coupled refinement is a real hypothesis with deployment stakes (surgical/aerial lighting); isolating refinement via model surgery (own note) is fiddly and version-fragile.
Centerline+width fields exist in vessel/crack literatures; the physically-measured (caliper) downstream accuracy comparison is the genuinely new leg and requires a small collection effort.

Defocus as a per-pixel sharpness oracle exposes metrics punishing physically-inevitable uncertainty; focal-stack calibration is the right anchor. Strong section of the boundary-metric-reform agenda, mid as standalone.
Contour-spectrum fingerprinting (identify the architecture from outputs alone) is an original forensic instrument; junction-parameterization issues are real but the restricted first version is clean.

Compression-determined recall ceilings with human verification reframe 'small-object failure' as pipeline policy; codec matrix is bounded work and the deployment gap it exposes is uncomfortable and real. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]
'Small objects are a search problem, not a segmentation problem' is the field-redirecting claim; shares machinery with 0015 (oracle decompositions) - one strong paper exists here, not two.
Normal/tangential decomposition is a plausible metric fix with a human-validation leg; the contour-correspondence ambiguity at large errors (own note) is where the math gets contestable.

A 'machine Bouma law' - dimensionless collapse of instance-merge probability - would be the first universal capability rating for dense scenes; curve collapse either happens or it doesn't, and both outcomes teach.

The blob-prior as a measurable transfer function (with attempted inversion) upgrades folklore to instrument; competes with 0153/0161 for the same decoder-as-filter paper - pick the strongest formulation.

Physical ground truth below annotation noise opens a measurement regime segmentation has never had; ecological-validity complaint is anticipated and answered by textured/embedded variants. Flagship-quality idea.
The granularity mismatch is real and under-quantified, but failure-detection-for-segmentation literature is converging on it; the cross-model transfer test is what would set it apart.

Calibration-leads-accuracy is a testable lead-lag claim, but classification-side shift studies (Ovadia-style) have circled it; the deployment version needs label-free ECE proxies, an extra unproven step.

Instance-vs-pixel as separate supervision currencies with a measured exchange rate redirects long-tail data collection; within-class subsampling design neutralizes the semantics confound. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

'An emergent capability being actively trained away by modal supervision' is a striking, measurable thesis connecting amodal completion to tracking robustness; synthetic-composite scale plus real validation subsets is the right data strategy.

The augmentation tax on exactly the hard classes this catalog cares about (transparency, camouflage, thin structures) is a unifying explanation candidate for several clusters' failures; factorial attribution across augmentation families is the standard fight.

Robust-fine-tuning frontier work (LP-FT, WiSE-FT era) covers the concept for classification; the dense-task frontier with a tuning-data-diversity predictor is a usable refinement rather than a discovery.

The inference-vs-training compute exchange rate for segmentation, stratified by input difficulty, imports the test-time-compute question into dense vision before the wave arrives; the label-free selection signal is the acknowledged prerequisite. [Demoted from KEEP by shortlist budget; revivable.]

'Part of boundary error is an unresolved disagreement about what boundaries MEAN' (functional vs photometric) reframes evaluation itself; the signed per-junction-type offset is measurable and the affordance grounding disciplines the taxonomy. Among the deepest ideas in the batch.

The deletion-similarity law ('classes visually similar to target negatives die first') and the dormancy-vs-deletion test are the fresh parts of an otherwise-known forgetting story; cheap rehearsal fix makes it practical.

Multi-modal (not noisy-binary) disagreement structure invalidating pairwise-agreement certification is foundational annotation theory; a 10-rater panel on 300 items is expensive but small compared to the claim's reach. Protect.

'When is the mask an unnecessary middleman' deflates segmentation's assumed universality with a matched-budget three-task test and an auditability-aware decision rule; the honest framing of regression's auditability loss preempts the obvious rebuttal.
